source_roster.rule: No demographic magnitude, trend direction, E, kappa, or concentration result enters this roster.

aei_mask.dataset: Antarctic Ecosystem Inventory: Spatial data for Ice-free lands v1.0
aei_mask.role: fixed potential-rock / mapped ice-free support for local observation QA; not a time-varying habitat outcome
aei_mask.caveat: Using the AEI mask means the first dynamic metric is change in summer exposure/visibility of independently mapped ice-free substrate, not total deglaciated land outside that mapped support.

landsat_qa.source: USGS Collection 2 QA_PIXEL carried through to Level-2
landsat_qa.clear_bit_rule: Do not rely on QA_PIXEL bit 6 alone; compute valid pixels explicitly from fill/cloud/shadow bits.
landsat_qa.scene_selection: Within each frozen early/late epoch, among austral-month scenes with scene cloud <=80%, choose at most five distinct years; within each year choose the lowest scene-cloud item; if >5 years remain, choose years nearest evenly spaced quantiles across the epoch.
landsat_qa.purpose: Measure local observation support over mapped ice-free substrate before opening any spectral habitat-change classifier.

pilot.rationale: Stress-test the full remote COG -> local AEI mask -> QA_PIXEL pipeline across geography and scene-support conditions before running all 84 sites.
selection_rule: Use only combined pixel-QA candidate sites.
For each of Central-west Antarctic Peninsula, South Shetland Islands and Victoria Land, select three physical sites spanning low, median and high early-scene support, ties by site_id.
For each smaller represented region, select one median-support physical site, ties by site_id.
Add Beaufort Island (BEAU) as the external positive-control site even if already selected.

per_scene: fraction of reprojected AEI support observed without fill/dilated-cloud/cloud/cloud-shadow flags
snow/ice fraction among locally valid AEI-support pixels
water-flag fraction among locally valid AEI-support pixels
per_epoch: minimum and maximum locally valid AEI-support fraction
number of scenes with locally valid fraction >=0.50

pilot_pass_rule.per_epoch: at least 3 selected distinct-year scenes and at least 2 scenes with >=0.50 locally valid AEI-support fraction
pilot_pass_rule.site: both early and late epochs pass
pilot_pass_rule.program: at least 11 of 14 pilot sites pass, Beaufort passes both epochs, and failures are not all concentrated in one of the three major regions
pilot_pass_rule.failure_action: Do not relax the pixel-validity threshold. Diagnose sensor/QA incompatibility outcome-blindly; if unresolved, stop the Landsat dynamic-land lane.

next_stage_if_passed.action: run identical local QA over all 84 candidate physical sites, then freeze a habitat-change classifier
next_stage_if_passed.classifier_rule: NDSI-only classification is not accepted as the sole primary method because Antarctic shade/cloud misclassification is documented; classifier validation must use independent spatial controls and Beaufort direction.

claim_boundary: Passing pixel QA means sufficient local observations exist; it is not evidence of habitat expansion.
QA snow flags are diagnostic at this stage and are not yet the final accessible-habitat metric.
The AEI mask is a fixed support layer, not occupied nesting area.
